messages:
Maya: Quick cross-team pulse — delivery status for the Optimize toolkit pieces. Need owners + blockers for: quant recommendations (8/4/6-bit profiles), batching knobs (dynamic batching thresholds), and cache eviction policies + regression alert tuning. Can owners confirm ETA? I want a short rollup by EOD Thu.

Jon: I can own the quant recs. Current blocker: perf benchmarks for the 8-bit kernel on A100 need cleaned results. PR 542 is merged but CI flakes on long-context tests. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

Li: I'll take the PR review this afternoon. Can you drop a minimal repro? The failing test looks like a KV-cache memory leak triggered at seq_len 4096.

Jon: repro snippet attached — run `pytest tests/quant_perf.py::test_long_context --runs 10` — env: `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 TF_FORCE_GPU_ALLOW_GROWTH=1`. I'm also seeing a 4-6% perf delta vs the v1 kernel; might be a kernel launch parameter.

Li: thx. Taking it. If anyone on eng-runtime can confirm kernel launch change rolled out in canary, ping me.

Sara: Ops note — staging has been noisy: cache eviction was evicting later than expected leading to KV cache bloat and spurious regression alerts yesterday 14:03 UTC. Filed incident: https://redwood.incidents/INC-1234. Root cause looks like a miss in the eviction policy when batch size spikes.

Nate: I can own the batching + cache config. Proposed rollout: canary 10% with `batch.max_tokens=2048`, `batch.timeout_ms=12`, and `cache.eviction_pct=0.15`. If no regressions in 24h, bump to 50% then 100%.

Maya: Nate — can you add the canary config to the rollout doc and include a short eval set we should watch? Link to doc: https://internal.redwood/deliveries/quant-batch-canary.

Nate: Done. Added eval set `quant-smoke-v1` and alert thresholds: p50 latency +5% and token-cost +3% within the first 4h triggers automatic rollback.

Li:Heads-up: merging the PR will create artifact `quant-kernel:v8-2027` which eng-runtime needs to publish. @ops-bot can you confirm artifact pipeline readiness?

ops-bot: artifact pipeline status: build queued -> compile -> smoke tests. Expected publish ETA 6 hours. Will post updates. :robot_face: 

Sara: dependency note — once artifact is published, infra needs a small config bump to enable 8-bit path for dedicated pools (ticket INF-557). ETA for infra change?

Maya: Who's on infra for INF-557? We need it done before canary starts tomorrow morning.

Jon: I can take INF-557 pairing with infra lead if needed. Quick question: do we keep fallback to 16-bit if 8-bit fails? My recommendation: yes — fallback to compatible variant with tagging for cost tracking.

Nate: Agreed. We'll route fallback via `model.variant=fallback-16bit` and mark metrics as `quant_experiment=true`.

Maya: OK owners summary: Jon -> quant recs + perf fix (PR review in progress), Li -> kernel review + validation, Nate -> batching/caching rollout config + canary, Sara -> monitor staging incident and confirm eviction fix, ops-bot -> artifact publish, Jon + infra -> INF-557. Blockers: CI flakes (Jon), eviction race (Sara), infra publish window (ops-bot). Please drop a one-line status update when your task moves (e.g., "Jon: PR review in progress — 60%").

Li: PR merged after review. Validation run passing 9/10 (one flaky test left).

Jon: CI fixed (flaky test tagged and quarantined). Perf numbers stable; baseline p50 token latency -3% on A100 with v8.

Nate: Canary started at 03:00 UTC with 10%. Observability checks running. No alerts in first 2 hours.

Sara: eviction patch deployed to staging at 02:45 UTC; monitored for 4h — stable. Incident INC-1234 closed.

ops-bot: artifact `quant-kernel:v8-2027` published at 01:20 UTC; digest sha256:abc123...

Maya: Great progress — timeline looks good for broader rollout tomorrow. Final ask: any remaining risks or hidden deps we should call out now?

Li: Risk: small regression on extreme prompt shapes (token compression edgecases). I'm adding a targeted eval and will flag if >1% regression.

Nate: Also note cost monitoring — we should ensure billing tags for experiment to avoid surprise invoices. I'll add tags as `experiment=quant-v8`.
